translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Nauman gail
book.title: Nauman gail Nǝsa ahai pispisul gail lotogole

content: Natub̃atan
Teofilus,
len nalob̃ulat ta m̃o sagw nuhol husur natit p̃isi aYesu totub̃at gole mai p̃usan hǝni vǝbar nǝboŋ aGot tolavi vi mǝhat vi lan nǝmav.
Len nǝboŋ savi mǝhat sal, len nǝdaŋan seNunun aGot, aYesu ikel nap̃isal hǝn nauman mai ahai pispisul gail totabtabuh len galit tia.

Husur na-lǝŋon-isa-an mai nǝmatan san, aYesu evisi hǝn galito, be imaur. Ale eṽusan nǝmauran san hǝn galito hǝn lǝb̃eris lǝboii ke imaur kitin. Gai evisi hǝn galito vǝha-sob̃ur len nǝmariboŋ tovi 40 ale isor husur natohan pipihabǝlan aGot.
Boŋ sua ihanhan mai galito, ale ikel nǝ-kai-tasi-an sua, ike, “Samteriŋ naut a Jerusalem, be mititoh vir naviolan aTǝmagw tokel gati tia. Egai nǝsa notokel mai gamito, mǝttosǝsǝloŋ hǝni;
husur aJon ibaptais hǝn nǝvanuan gail hǝn nǝwai be asike idareh aGot tibaptais hǝn gamito hǝn aNunun.”
AYesu evi mǝhat vi lan nǝmav
Ŋa nǝboŋ lotob̃onb̃on, lousi ke, “Nasub̃, imabe? Gagai gilav tǝlmam hǝn naut a Israel titoh pipihabǝlan nakiŋ salit gabag tǝtas am a?”
Be ikel mai galito ke, “Savi samito hǝn mǝtb̃elǝboi namityal o nǝmariboŋ aTǝmagw toriŋi len nǝdaŋan hǝn na-il-a-m̃o-an san.
Dereh mitikad nǝdaŋan nǝboŋ aNunun aGot b̃egǝm len gamito. Dereh mitikel ur ginau len naut a Jerusalem, len naprovens Jutea mai naut a Samaria van vǝbar tarhǝt navile a pan.”
Nǝboŋ aYesu tokǝmaienan tonoŋ, aGot ilavi vi mǝhat vi lan nǝmav. Lokǝta husuri van nǝmavukasw esusuani.
Nǝboŋ tovi mǝhat lokǝtkǝta vi mǝhat, vǝha-sua ŋai nǝvanuan eru arovisi, il mai galito. Arosun nahurabat topǝhapǝhw.
Aruke, “UleKalili gail, imabe mǝtokǝta vi mǝhat maienan? AYesu egaii aGot tolavi vi mǝhat dan gamito, dereh tetǝlmam sum̃an tovi mǝhat.”
Logǝgel hǝn aJutas
Beti luyar tǝlmam dan Naṽehuh Oliv enan, vi Jerusalem. Evi nǝyaran hǝn nǝSappat, nakilomita esua ŋai.

Nǝboŋ lotobar naut enan, lopǝlau vi lohoim len naim a mǝhat lototohtoh lan. Ikad aPita, aJon, aJemes, aAdru, aFilip, aTomas, aPartolomiu, aMattiu, aJemes anatun aAlfeus, aSimon tovi Selot sua, mai aJutas anatun aJemes.
Len nǝnauan sua lub̃onb̃on tabtab hǝn lǝb̃isor tuṽ, galit mai alatpǝhaṽut mai aMeri anan aYesu, mai aṽan aYesu gail.
Len nǝboŋ galen sua, APita eil rivuh len ahai susur gail. Galito lovi 120.
Ike, “Bathudud sagw, sutuai aNunun aGot isor len nabuŋon aTevit husur aJutas. Nǝsa aGot tokele len natosian san isarpoh hum nasoruan san tosarpoh akis. AJutas eil a m̃o hǝn alat lototah gat aYesu,
naut kǝmas gai tovi ginamit sua. Gai ikad nahudhuuman egai siGot sum̃an gidato.”
(AJutas eṽur nǝtan hǝn nǝvat tokade sil naṽide san tosa. Ale iteh, sueh nǝtan, nabǝhaṽun imap̃ul, ale ninen elul vivile.
Nǝboŋ alat a Jerusalem p̃isi lotosǝsǝloŋ lǝboi natenan, loriŋ nǝhes len nǝtan enan. Len nasoruan salito evi Akeltama, Marireu hǝn Nǝda bolai.)
APita isor am ike, “Len nalob̃ulat hǝn Nǝb̃e gail aTevit itosi ke,
mai,

“Imaienan, ivoi ke alateg ideh tegǝm vi vanuan sua len gidat dattosǝŋavur pisan esua. Avan enan tevi vanuan sua toyar mai gidat akis nǝboŋ aYesu totah mai gidato, tub̃at len nǝboŋ aJon tobaptais hǝn aYesu van vǝbar aGot tolav kuvi dan gidato. Hum gidato, avan enan eris aYesu tomaur tǝtas ale timasb̃on mai gidato hǝn datb̃ikel ur na-le-mǝhat-an enan san dan nǝmatan.”
Ŋa nǝboŋ aPita tokel naten tonoŋ, lulekis hǝn naulum̃an eru. Esua nahǝsan aJosef lotokisi hǝn aParsappas (lokisi hǝn aJustus am), togon nahǝsan aMattias.
Beti lusor mai aGot ke, “Nasub̃, gaiug m̃au golǝboi nǝlon nǝvanuan p̃isi. Gigol p̃arp̃ar hǝn tesua len gǝlar egai gototabtabuh lan tia
hǝn b̃ilav namilen aJutas hǝn nauman san mai nauman sihai pispisul. AJutas ipair dani vǝsab.”
Ale lubar hǝn nǝvat hǝn lǝb̃isab̃ ase len gǝlaru. Lusab̃ aMattias ale ib̃on mai ahai pispisul sǝŋavur pisan esua.

footnotes.text: 1.1 Len nasoruan ta Kris namilen aTeofilus evi nabubur siGot.
